text: Food science is an expansive, interdisciplinary field dedicated to understanding the molecular composition, physical properties, and chemical changes that occur in food. It is far more complex than mere culinary arts; it combines principles from chemistry, biology, microbiology, and engineering to ensure that the food we consume is safe, nutritious, palatable, and available year-round. At its core, the field seeks to improve the entire food supply chain, from the farm to the dinner plate. One of the most critical applications of food science is food preservation. Scientists develop sophisticated techniques—such as pasteurization, lyophilization (freeze-drying), and advanced packaging—to inhibit the growth of pathogenic microorganisms and slow down enzymatic degradation.
